items.title: Celsius Holdings outlook lifted to positive by S&P as leverage falls to 1.7x
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings revised its outlook on Celsius Holdings Inc (NASDAQ:CELH) to positive from stable on Monday, signaling potential for a credit upgrade as the energy drink maker’s expanded brand portfolio offsets near-term softness in its flagship label. The rating agency affirmed Celsius’ ‘BB-’ issuer credit rating alongside its ‘BB+’ issue-level rating on the company's existing revolver and term loan, citing strong operating momentum and reduced debt leverage.
